title: Upstream `mama` assessment record (import interface)
description: The record emitted by upstream `autonomy-score --json` (ruleset 2.0.0), as imported by mama-integrations. Fields are stored and displayed EXACTLY AS ISSUED — no field in this schema may be recomputed, renamed, or re-weighted by MAMA. Ruleset version gate: MAJOR 2 supported; MAJOR 1 retired (rejected with migration guidance); other majors fail closed.

ruleset_version.description: Upstream RULESET_VERSION. Persisted with every stored record.

scores.description: Six dimension scores, 0-5 each: D1 decision clarity, D2 capability, D3 guardrails, D4 telemetry, D5 transparency, D6 accountability. Displayed as issued; the weakest-link rule min(D3,D4,D6) is upstream's, never recomputed here.

safe_grant_level.description: Upstream's weakest-link safe level, as issued.

granted_level.description: Currently granted level; null = no formal grant (Submarine Line context).

recommended_move.description: Upstream management-move recommendation, verbatim. MAMA context may inform the grantor; it never overrides this.
